file_contents: This OCR file holds BOTH parts of AA 3: pars prior (Victor Vitensis, Historia persecutionis, ed. C. Halm, 1879; lines 1-10520) and pars posterior (Corippus, ed. I. Partsch, 1879; lines 10522-35594).

texts.work: Victor Vitensis, Historia persecutionis Africanae provinciae

sigla.manuscript: Laudunensis 113 (only lib. II 56-101, the Liber fidei catholicae, plus the Notitia)
Bernensis 48 (cited only for its own readings)
editio Coloniensis (R. Lorichius), reprinted from p

evidence.quote: Librorum manu scriptorum, qui Victoris Vitensis historiam continent, genera sunt duo, lectionum diversitate multum inter se distantia.

in hac codicum familia librarii neglegentia, qui archetypum exaraverat, haud pauca vocabula omissa sunt, quae in altera codicum familia, cuius longe optimus Bruxellensis est, integra inveniuntur; velut ... desunt in BLV
Etiam maiores lacunae in altera codicum familia (Rp) deprehenduntur
Bern. = codex Bernensis n. 48 saec. XI. Is cum plerumque cum R conspiret, sed eo multo deterior sit
editionis quoque Parisinae lectionibus, quamquam multo deterior est codice Bruxellensi ex eodem fonte originem ducente
codicis Laudunensis omnium longe optimi testimonio comprobatur, cuius bonae lectiones modo in BV, modo in R inveniuntur

texts.notes: Two families (BLV vs R-Bern.-p) are explicit. A is NOT assigned to either family: Halm says its good readings sit now with BV, now with R, so A may be a third independent branch, but he never says so; recorded outside top_branches. A covers only II 56-101. Within BLV Halm calls B and V the best of their family (often cited as BV against L), but states no BV subgroup.

texts.work: Corippus, In laudem Iustini Augusti minoris libri IV

sigla.manuscript: Matritensis Cajon 14 Num. 22 (olim Ovetensis, Ruiz's codex)
Fragmentum Ovetense (lost; known only from Ruiz's margin), III 271-407 only
Codex Santonensis (lost; via Vinetus 1552), 'Epistola regis Avarum' = III 271-288 only
Laurentianus plut. 45, 26 fol. 115 (in Sidonius MS), III 271-288 only

evidence.quote: Stemma librorum hoc fere fuisse arbitror. [diagram: X -> Matritensis, Y; Y -> fragmentum Ovetense -> Z -> Santonensis, Laurentianus]
librum Ovetensem, ut hominum cognationis nominibus utar, Matritensis nec filium nec fratrem, sed fratris forsitan filium fuisse suspicor.
interpolatos libros aut ex Ovetensi ipso, aut e codice eiusdem familiae originem ducere statuerim.
Panegyrici quoque in laudem Iustini minoris editio, si paucissimos locos exceperis, in uno codice nititur

texts.notes: The diagram is printed (OCR keeps only the labels X, Matritensis, Y, fragmentum Ovetense, Z, Santonensis, Laurentianus; I reconstructed the edges from the text, check against the image). The stemma only concerns III 271-407 (O) and III 271-288 (S, L): the rest rests on M alone, so the text is in practice single-manuscript and will fail the witness rule. O, S, L are excerpt traditions, hence 'indirect'. The apparatus mostly records M readings positively ('pulcerrima M').

skipped.work: Victor Vitensis, Passio beatissimorum martyrum (VII monachorum)
skipped.reason: short appendix (c. 4 pp.) carried with the Historia in the same manuscripts (BLRV, p); no separate filiation, so covered by the Historia record and could be merged into it
single manuscript (T, Trivultianus s. XIV) plus a few lines in the Florilegium Veronense (V, indirect); no filiation
